rows.title: General Updates
rows.summary: Sudarshan Chemical Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about followingThis is in furtherance to our intimations dated 1st September, 2026, wherein the Company had submitted copy of the Investors Presentation relating to execution of definitive Share Purchase and Transfer Agreement for sale of 100% stake in VP4 Frankfurt GmbH, a Step-Down Wholly-Owned Subsidiary of the Company.Post submission, a typographical error was noticed on slide no. 3 of the Investors Presentation.The name mentioned therein to be read as  Mitsui & Co. . Revised Presentation is enclosed herewith.

rows.title: General Updates
rows.summary: Sudarshan Chemical Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about followingPursuant to the provisions of Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations, 2015 and in furtherance to our intimation and Press Release dated 1st September, 2026 regarding execution of definitive Share Purchase and Transfer Agreement for sale of 100% stake in VP4 Frankfurt GmbH, a Step-Down Wholly-Owned Subsidiary of the Company, we attach herewith a copy of the Investors Presentation, contents of which are self-explanatory.

rows.title: Press Release
rows.summary: Sudarshan Chemical Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated September 01, 2026, titled "Sudarshan Chemical Divests VP4 Frankfurt to Celanese, Sharpening Focus on Core Pigments Business".
